title: A Biophysical Hypothesis for Compartment-Specific Conformational States of the IQSEC2 Intrinsically Disordered Protein.
authors: Shokhen, Michael; Albeck, Amnon; Levy, Nina S; Levy, Andrew P
one_liner_zh: 该文通过加速分子动力学模拟研究IQSEC2这一内在无序蛋白在不同细胞区室中的构象状态，并探讨力场和水模型对折叠预测的影响，属于蛋白质构象采样与结构计算研究，与本课题高度相关。
abstract: The postsynaptic density (PSD) of neuronal synapses is a crowded, viscous membraneless compartment consisting of densely packed protein mixtures formed and maintained through liquid-liquid phase separation. A key regulator of synaptic function within the PSD is IQSEC2, an intrinsically disordered protein (IDP), which functions as a guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF), promoting the activation of the small GTPase ARF6 by catalyzing the exchange of ARF6 bound GDP for GTP. Experiments have shown that IQSEC2 is inactive in a folded state in the dendritic cytosol but can transiently adopt a catalytically active extended conformation in the PSD upon activation by neurotransmitter mediated calcium influx. In this study, we performed accelerated molecular dynamics (aMD) simulations of the IQSEC2 folding process in aqueous solvent and applied the Gibbs ergodic hypothesis formulated in statistical ensembles for post-processing and analysis of the results. We compared the effects of two sets of parameters on folding: a force field and a water model. The OPC water model optimized for proteins with disordered structure in the extended state in bulk aqueous solvent predicted an incorrect distorted 3D folded structure of IQSEC2. We propose that, due to fundamental biophysical differences between the dendritic cytosol and the postsynaptic density, there are two distinct classes of IDPs functioning in these different environments. These differences should be considered when optimizing force fields and parameters of water models for studying protein folding.
abstract_zh: 神经元突触的突触后致密区（PSD）是一个拥挤、粘稠的无膜区室，由密集堆积的蛋白质混合物组成，并通过液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation）形成和维持。PSD内突触功能的关键调节因子是IQSEC2，一种 intrinsically disordered protein (IDP)，其作为鸟嘌呤核苷酸交换因子（GEF），通过催化ARF6结合的GDP与GTP的交换，促进小GTP酶ARF6的激活。实验表明，IQSEC2在树突细胞质中的折叠状态下无活性，但在神经递质介导的钙内流激活后，可在PSD中瞬时采用催化活性的延伸构象。在本研究中，我们进行了加速分子动力学（accelerated molecular dynamics, aMD）模拟，以研究IQSEC2在水溶液中的折叠过程，并应用统计系综中表述的吉布斯遍历假设对结果进行后处理和分析。我们比较了两组参数对折叠的影响：力场和水模型。针对具有无序结构延伸状态的蛋白质优化的OPC水模型，在体相水溶液中预测了IQSEC2错误的扭曲三维折叠结构。我们提出，由于树突细胞质和突触后致密区之间的基本生物物理差异，在这些不同环境中存在两类不同的IDP。在优化研究蛋白质折叠的力场和水模型参数时，应考虑这些差异。
